mapper.sql: id, passenger_info_id, out_trade_no, amount, pay_type, status, trade_no, paid_time, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: insert into tbl_wallet_recharge (passenger_info_id, out_trade_no, amount, pay_type, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{passengerInfoId}, #{outTradeNo}, #{amount}, #{payType}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select:
select
from tbl_wallet_recharge where out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} limit 1
mapper.update: update tbl_wallet_recharge set status = #{status}, trade_no = #{tradeNo}, paid_time = now(), update_time = now() where out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} and status = 0
